Audio, subtitles & implementation notes

The picture, original logo, typefaces and nine supplied voice recordings are embedded. Ambient sound has been removed. Mute controls narration. Showreel.audio === null because the clips remain separate rather than a combined export mix. Each clip is cut at its specified deadline. Playback pauses when this tab becomes hidden.

The buttons below create separate subtitle files with the nine voice cues. Captions are DOM-only and never enter the exported canvas, regardless of the subs argument. The embedded voice clips play in this preview; the exporter receives no mixed soundtrack while audio is null.

Gentle Shell is a console-integrated workspace built for Pi, whose core coding-agent capabilities remain distinct from this workspace layer. Focused agents receive bounded work and return to a parent that retains context and control. Small work may stay in that parent. Changes represents successful write/edit tool changes from this session and owned children; it does not represent every shell/editor write or complete Git history. All session content is newly drawn, abstract word bars. Only the supplied intact logo image is embedded; none of the console reference images are embedded. No memory availability, savings, approval or release guarantee is implied.

Render contract: await Showreel.ready, then call Showreel.draw(ctx, frame / 30, {format:'16x9', subs:'none'}) for frames 0…1319. The endpoint at 44 seconds is also supported. Draw resets the canvas and derives the entire frame only from absolute time, format and decoded assets.

Checks performed on the original film: all 1,320 frames per format rendered with @napi-rs/canvas in Node, plus 42 sampled frames including 0, 1/30, 39.99, 40, 40.35, 40.75, 41.25 and 44 seconds. Both layouts and opening/closing boundary contact sheets were visually inspected. Sixteen repeated nonadjacent-time comparisons passed pixel equality with none/en/es subtitle arguments and deliberately altered context state. The exact six-key Showreel contract and original logo bytes were checked. All nine voice windows and pause/seek/format/visibility stops were checked using DOM and audio test doubles, not actual media playback. No browser was run: Chromium was unavailable and its download failed. Browser offline font loading, continuous playback, actual voice-clip listening, and the recipient’s exporter/MP4 remain untested. This revision embeds the nine supplied voice clips. Actual browser playback has not been checked for this revision.
